read_pfm_file: read a PFM file from disk and return the numpy data array and scale factor
write_pfm_file: write a float32 numpy image array to a PFM file with an optional scale value
read_image_rgb: read an image file and return an RGB numpy array normalized to 0-1 range
resize_image_for_network: resize an image to network-compatible dimensions and return a PyTorch tensor batch
write_depth_map: write a depth map array to a PNG file with optional colormap and bit depth
